name: hidden-square
note: overflow:hidden on a square (no border-radius) box clips its subtree to the padding box: a child that pokes out of the right/bottom edges and a negative-margin child poking out the top/left are both cut. No border, so border and padding boxes coincide and the rect clip is pixel-exact against Chrome. overflow:hidden also establishes a BFC, so the negative-margin first child's top margin does not collapse through the box.
